package postgres

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// SectionLessonRepoPG implements SectionLessonRepository.
type SectionLessonRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

func (r SectionLessonRepoPG) ReplaceBySection(ctx context.Context, sectionID string, items []domain.CatalogRelationOrder) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM section_lesson WHERE section_id=$1`, sectionID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, item := range items {
		if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO section_lesson (id, section_id, lesson_id, "order", status) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,1) ON CONFLICT (section_id, lesson_id) DO UPDATE SET "order"=EXCLUDED."order", status=EXCLUDED.status, updated_at=now()`,
			uuid.NewString(), sectionID, item.ChildID, item.Order); err != nil {
			return mapPgError(err)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (r SectionLessonRepoPG) Add(ctx context.Context, sectionID string, lessonID string, order int) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO section_lesson (id, section_id, lesson_id, "order", status) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,1) ON CONFLICT (section_id, lesson_id) DO UPDATE SET "order"=EXCLUDED."order", status=EXCLUDED.status, updated_at=now()`,
		uuid.NewString(), sectionID, lessonID, order)
	return mapPgError(err)
}

func (r SectionLessonRepoPG) Delete(ctx context.Context, sectionID string, lessonID string) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM section_lesson WHERE section_id=$1 AND lesson_id=$2`, sectionID, lessonID)
	return err
}

var _ repository.SectionLessonRepository = (*SectionLessonRepoPG)(nil)
